name: A College Education
source:
Molly (name can be changed) is entering her senior year at college. Will she make it through the year with her current relationships in tact? Or will she veer off course?​

[From F95Zone]
translation:
莫莉（名字可更改）即将升入大学四年级。她能否在维系好现有感情关系的前提下顺利度过这一年？还是会偏离原有的轨道？
